reviews.title: Good option if no ARGB connection on the motherboard.
reviews.comment: Good color. Quiet. Easy to Install.  Option for 12 or 5 volt.
reviews.author: Guy

reviews.title: Good for what Its Used For
reviews.comment: We bought these for our son to play with, with a 12v usb fan adapter.  He loves them.  The color is great.  The fans have stood up to rugged handling by our son and they are quiet.  Compared to other fans on the market the value was great too - we got the pack of three for roughly what we would pay for 1 fan at Best Buy.
reviews.author: Sonickat

reviews.comment: Hasen su trabajo pero las luces no se pueden cambiar pera iniciar esta bien
reviews.author: Edisson Fernando Ruiz

reviews.title: you get what you pay for
reviews.comment: For the price, these do what they were advertised to do.  I needed something I could plug into molex since the motherboard I was working with didn't have enough fan headers, and my son wanted RGB and didn't care if there was no controller, so these fit the bill.
reviews.author: Jonathan
